copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Microsoft Teams 支持：复制并注册 Teams 适配器、安装固定版本依赖、跑构建与注册测试，再用 Teams CLI 创建机器人、把凭据写入 .env，并把助手接到指定 Teams 账号。
howto.when: 当你想让 NanoClaw 助手接入 Microsoft Teams（团队频道、群聊、私聊）时触发。技能会先检查 .env 是否已有 Teams 凭据，有则跳过全部创建步骤直接重启。

say.text: 帮我把助手接入 Microsoft Teams。
say.note: 会创建机器人并把凭据写进 .env。

say.text: 我的隧道地址变了，更新一下机器人端点。
say.note: 用 teams app update 更新端点。

howto.what_en: Adds Microsoft Teams support to NanoClaw: copies, registers and installs the Teams adapter, then builds, runs the registration test, creates a bot via the Teams CLI, stores credentials, and wires the assistant to a Teams user.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want the NanoClaw assistant in Microsoft Teams (team channels, group chats, DMs). If .env already holds Teams credentials, the create steps are skipped and it goes straight to restart.

say_en.text: Add Microsoft Teams to my assistant.
say_en.note: Creates the bot and writes credentials.

say_en.text: My tunnel URL changed — update the bot endpoint.
Wire the assistant to another Teams user with Entra object ID 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.
